setup.title: System setup
setup.sub: Server environment variables — status only, values are never shown
setup.restart: Change it in .env.local (your machine) or in the host's Environment Variables page, then restart the server
setup.devWarning: [setup] These values are missing or test values (details at /admin/setup or in .env.example):

APP_SECRET.purpose: The app's secret: signs short-lived API tokens and salts IP hashes
APP_SECRET.where: Generate it: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64'))" and paste the output (at least 32 characters)
APP_SECRET.missingProd: API tokens and voice submissions fail (error)

NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.purpose: The site's public address, used for the sitemap, hreflang links and Open Graph
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.where: Your deployed domain, e.g. https://council.utd.ac.th (Vercel → Project → Settings → Domains), no trailing / — Should be https://utdsc.com (the primary domain); anything else shows a warning
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL.missingProd: Sitemap / share links point to localhost

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.purpose: The Supabase project (database, sign-in, photo storage)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.where: supabase.com → your project → Project Settings → Data API → Project URL (https://xxxx.supabase.co, no /rest/v1)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.missingDev: Site uses sample data from content/seed.json; no back office
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL.missingProd: No real content, nobody can sign in

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.purpose: Supabase public key, reads approved content (limited by RLS)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.where: supabase.com → Project Settings → API Keys → Publishable key (or the Legacy tab → anon public)
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.missingProd: No real content, nobody can sign in

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.purpose: Supabase admin key (bypasses RLS), server-side only after a role check: approvals, photo uploads, voice messages
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.where: supabase.com → Project Settings → API Keys → Secret key (or Legacy → service_role) — never in browser code
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.missingDev: Voice messages go to .data/voice.jsonl; approve/upload don't work
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.missingProd: Voice form rejects submissions; back office doesn't work

UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL.purpose: Redis for rate limits and the IP ban list, shared by every server instance
UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL.where: upstash.com → Redis → Create Database → database page → REST API tab → UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL (starts with https://, not rediss://)
UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL.missingProd: Each instance limits on its own — weaker bot protection

UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN.purpose: Read/write token for the Redis above
UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN.where: upstash.com → database page → REST API tab → UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN (the normal token, not the Readonly token)

GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION.purpose: Google Search Console ownership by HTML tag (meta google-site-verification) — not needed once a Domain property is verified by DNS TXT
GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION.where: Search Console → add a URL-prefix property → HTML tag method → copy only the content="..." value
GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION.missingProd: No verification tag (DNS verification works instead)

BING_SITE_VERIFICATION.purpose: Bing Webmaster Tools ownership by HTML tag (meta msvalidate.01)
BING_SITE_VERIFICATION.where: bing.com/webmasters → Add site → HTML Meta Tag → copy only the content="..." value (or import from Google Search Console without it)
BING_SITE_VERIFICATION.missingProd: No verification tag (import from Google works instead)

PROTECTION_MODE.purpose: Anti-code-fetching protection: strict (default) = server gate + copy/shortcut/print blocking + DevTools detection; relaxed = without DevTools detection; off = everything off (source maps still refused). Signed-in admins never get the browser-side blocking
PROTECTION_MODE.where: Set it on the host (strict, relaxed or off) and redeploy

DEV_BYPASS_SECRET.purpose: Owner bypass: open any page with ?dev=<value> to get a 1-hour HttpOnly cookie that skips the gate and every browser-side block (24+ characters)
DEV_BYPASS_SECRET.where: Generate one, e.g. node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'))"; set it on the host only

LIGHTHOUSE_TOKEN.purpose: Secret (32+ characters) for Lighthouse runs with scripts/lighthouse.mjs: the script signs a 15-minute token that passes the anti-code-fetching gate; no User-Agent is ever allowlisted
LIGHTHOUSE_TOKEN.where: Generate one, e.g. node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('base64url'))"; put the same value in .env.local of the machine running the script and on the host
LIGHTHOUSE_TOKEN.missingDev: Lighthouse only gets in when the gate accepts it as a browser
LIGHTHOUSE_TOKEN.missingProd: Lighthouse only gets in when the gate accepts it as a browser

RATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_IPS.purpose: IPs exempt from the site's own rate limits (comma-separated, IPv4/IPv6 and CIDR, e.g. 203.0.113.7,2001:db8::/48) — bot blocks, bans and Cloudflare still apply
RATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_IPS.where: Sign in as an administrator and open /api/admin/whoami; the ip value is the address the server sees
RATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_IPS.missingDev: Every IP is limited as usual
RATE_LIMIT_ALLOW_IPS.missingProd: Every IP is limited as usual (signed-in administrators are already exempt)

NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.purpose: Cloudflare Turnstile public key (the "not a bot" check) on the voice form
NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.where: dash.cloudflare.com → Turnstile → Add widget → add the site's domain → Site Key — test key 1x00000000000000000000AA (always passes)
NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.missingProd: No widget and the form never passes

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.purpose: Turnstile secret, verifies the check on the server
TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.where: dash.cloudflare.com → Turnstile → your widget → Secret Key — test key 1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA (always passes)

ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN.purpose: Email domain allowed into the back office (school Google accounts)
ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAIN.where: The school's email domain, default utd.ac.th — set only to change it

ADMIN_EMAILS.purpose: Bootstrap owner emails (comma-separated): the first sign-in creates an owner row in admin_users; afterwards manage them on Users & permissions (must be Google-verified)
ADMIN_EMAILS.where: The owners' Google addresses, e.g. admin1@utd.ac.th,someone@gmail.com — once signed in, the users page decides
ADMIN_EMAILS.missingProd: No bootstrap owner — the owners already in admin_users still work

GOOGLE_OAUTH.purpose: Google sign-in (not an .env value — configured in Supabase)
GOOGLE_OAUTH.where: 1) console.cloud.google.com → APIs & Services → Credentials → Create credentials → OAuth client ID → Web application → Authorized redirect URI: https://<project>.supabase.co/auth/v1/callback  2) supabase.com → Authentication → Sign In / Providers → Google → enable, paste Client ID + Client Secret  3) Authentication → URL Configuration → Site URL = NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL, add <SITE_URL>/auth/callback to Redirect URLs
